name: Preacher of the Schism

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, create a 1/1 white Vampire creature token with lifelink.
Whenever ~ attacks while you have the most life or are tied for most life, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

notes: APPROXIMATIONS: (1) no trigger event can restrict WHICH player is attacked, so the token trigger fires on any attack rather than only on an attack against the player with the most life; (2) 'you have the most life or are tied for most life' is written as the intervening condition 'more-life-than-opponent' (more life than AN opponent), the closest condition the vocabulary has; it misses the tie case and, in multiplayer, is looser than 'the most life'. Both need a life-standing condition family (see needs).

problems: round trip 0.48 < 0.55: "Whenever ~ attacks while you have the most life or are tied for most life, you draw a card and you lose 1 life." rendered as "whenever ~ attacks, if you have more life than an opponent, you draw a card. you lose 1 life"
